_comment: Vacuous-test ratchet baselines (tkt-d88902f60f7c). `max` is a CEILING, not a target: the gate fails when a repo exceeds it, and it should only ever be revised DOWN. `path` is relative to the kanban repo root and BINDS the row to a tree, so the ratchet cannot sweep one repo and report another's ceiling. `files`/`blocks` are read as a breadth floor, so a collapsed sweep fails instead of scoring a clean 0. `enforced` marks rows some gate actually checks — only kanban today, because the probe lives in this repo and another repo's CI cannot reach it.
_regenerate: Do not hand-edit the counts. Run: node -e 'import("./scripts/probe/vacuous-tests.mjs").then(m=>{for(const [r,p] of Object.entries(require("./scripts/probe/vacuous-baseline.json").repos).map(([k,v])=>[k,v.path])){const s=m.sweep(p);console.log(r,s.files,s.blocks,s.candidates.length)}})' — the numbers below were generated that way, not transcribed.
_countsAreFloors: Counts are STILL FLOORS, not totals (tkt-9c818426feb3 narrowed the gap, it did not close it). isComputed now resolves a variable declared in the SAME test block and sees through [...spread], but these remain undetected: a collection declared in the enclosing describe/beforeEach or at module scope; two-level indirection (const b = a); reassignment (let xs = []; xs = compute()); an out-param filled by a call (const rows = []; collect(rows)); and .forEach on a chained call, where the receiver regex mis-captures. Do not read a 0 as proof of clean.
_attribution: How the 08-11 numbers moved (tkt-9c818426feb3), measured by running the PRE-FIX probe against today trees so the two causes are separable. ticket-workflow 0 -> 6: only +1 is the fix, +5 are NEW vacuous tests added since 08-11 (its test files went 9 -> 17) and are tracked, not excused. equipment-schedule 19 -> 25: +4 fix, +2 new. copart-filter 4 -> 5: +1 fix. kanban stayed 0 because its one candidate was FIXED, not ceilinged (server/terminalAuth.test.ts asserted a container mount boundary entirely inside an unpinned loop). Raising a ceiling is a debt record, never an excuse: the split above is what says which part still needs fixing.
_lowered: 2026-08-16, tkt-898aaec13fb1: ticket-workflow 6 -> 0. The repo was re-swept before the fix and reported 8, not the 6 recorded here — two more had landed since (an audit control, and the byte-for-byte template drift check whose IDENTICAL list is matched by targetPath, so renaming an entry silenced it entirely). All eight are fixed upstream, each pin sitting outside its loop; see ticket-workflow#53. Breadth floors in every row below were regenerated in the same run, because a floor left behind is a collapsed sweep this ratchet would not notice.
